name: Pickup — Balas +3 (Común)
generation_strategy: IMAGEN INDIVIDUAL 1024×1024. Un solo pickup centrado en canvas transparente. Tight bbox crop → resize 48×48.

frames.prompt: A single cartoon game collectible pickup item centered on a fully transparent background. The item is a floating AMMO PACK containing 3 cartoon bullet cartridges. The cartridges are short fat golden-brass cylinders (bullet casings) with bright glowing green-lime tips (#44DD00), arranged in a small tight triangle cluster. Each cartridge has a bold dark charcoal outline, warm cel-shaded gradient on the brass body (bright gold highlight on top, warm amber midtone, dark brown shadow). The green tips glow softly, emitting a small lime-green aura. The whole cluster floats with a faint circular lime-green energy glow around it. A tiny sparkle star above the cluster. Cartoon proportions — fat and chunky, immediately reads as AMMUNITION. Bold dark charcoal outlines throughout. Transparent background, nothing else.
